assets.caption: EXHIBIT 11-11 — Pipe Rack Meter Runs. Elevation/side view of a pipe rack showing horizontal pipes supported on structural beams at multiple levels. The upper section depicts piping with orifice flanges (labeled "ORIFICE FLANGES") arranged in a meter run configuration with vertical riser legs and connections. A vertical "LADDER" is shown attached to the rack structure providing access. Multiple parallel pipes run horizontally across the rack at the lower levels.
